question: What fixed inbound WebSocket message ceiling should QQBot enforce without rejecting legitimate gateway events?
rationale: The transport mechanism is sound, but official QQ documentation gives no maximum event size and sibling channels intentionally use different caps, so repository evidence cannot safely select 1 MiB on maintainer behalf.

options.title: Use 16 MiB compatibility margin
options.body: Match the merged Discord gateway precedent, reducing the upstream 100 MiB exposure while leaving substantially more room for undocumented QQBot event growth.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB with QQ evidence
options.body: Keep the proposed limit only if a QQBot owner can cite production captures or a platform contract showing all legitimate events remain below it.

options.title: Choose another fixed owner limit
options.body: Select a different plugin-local ceiling and require loopback proof immediately below and above that exact threshold.

recommendation.title: Use 16 MiB compatibility margin
recommendation.body: Match the merged Discord gateway precedent, reducing the upstream 100 MiB exposure while leaving substantially more room for undocumented QQBot event growth.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current QQBot gateway architecture and are the strongest feature-history routing candidate for a channel-specific payload policy.
